title: Hazy Malaysian Padron Peppers Stew
description: A smoky, dense one-pot stew featuring padron peppers and a bhuna-inspired flavor profile, low in calories and perfect for a hearty lunch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomato puree and stir to combine.
Add the smoked paprika and soy sauce, mixing well.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the padron peppers and tamarind paste, covering the peppers with liquid.
Let the stew cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peppers are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.
Optional: Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
